M0955.Operators_source_GEM: Afşin- Elbistan Elektrik Üretim ve Ticaret A.Ş
M0955.Parent_company_source_GEM: Euas Electricity Generation Company (Elektrik Üretim A.Ş, EÜAŞ) (100.0%)
M0955.Carbon_bomb_description: The Afşin-Elbistan coal mines are a network of opencast and underground mines, operated by Afşin- Elbistan Elektrik Üretim ve Ticaret A.Ş. (Afşin Elbistan Electricity Production and Trade inc.) and owned by Electricity Generation Company (Elektrik Üretim A.Ş, EÜAŞ) with a capacity of 14 million tonnes per annum, in Kahramanmaraş, Turkey.

M0050.Carbon_bomb_description: The Hunter Valley South coal mine is a surface mine located in Lemington, New South Wales, Australia. Alongside Hunter Valley North coal mine, it comprises the Hunter Valley Operations (HVO) — a joint venture between Yancoal Australia (51%) and Glencore (49%).

M0564.Carbon_bomb_description: The Kusmunda coal mine is an open cast mine complex, operated by South Eastern Coalfields Limited, a subsidiary of Coal India, with a capacity of 62.5 million tonnes-per-annum (MTPA) in  Korba, Chhattisgarh, India.
